questions.stem:
A rectangle has length 15 centimeters and width 9 centimeters. What is its area, in square centimeters?
A) 135
B) 48
C) 24
D) 225
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 15 × 9 = 135.

questions.stem:
What is the area of the triangle shown, in square units?
F) 126
G) 23
H) 46
J) 63
questions.explanation: Triangle area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 14 × 9 = 63.
